handoff.authorityNote: This 'handoff' block is informational. STATE.json is GOVERNANCE_EXEMPT (autonomy.mjs), so a routine PR can edit it; therefore handoff.status (including any future TRANSFERRED value) NEVER grants, widens or transfers authority. Authority comes only from docs/planning/autonomy/standing-authority.json and Founder-merged records under docs/planning/authority/. V2 and V4.1 must ignore handoff.status as an authority source.

sharedStoreRequirements: 1. A shared durable store both coordinator sessions can write: refs/uasco/* or a dedicated branch refs/heads/uasco/authority. V2 reports HTTP 403 for refs/uasco/* from its session git proxy; access is chosen when a session starts, so a V2 session with that access may have to be started. A Founder-merged governance record (docs/planning/authority/*.md or standing-authority.json) must name the authority ref, the allowed coordinator session ids and the transfer gates (independent CLEAN review, green required CI, Founder decision id, drain acknowledgement). V2 must validate the ref content against that record.

3. V2's own code (claude/nice-sagan-c1zzow) must pass independent review, required CI and a Founder merge; its protected apps/control-api/src/server.ts change is a separate Founder-tier PR. Its open PR #347 failed the adapter-reality census at 4e02fbb7 (COMMAND_UNMAPPED:curl); V2 reports curl removed in 89cf3649 — re-verify on its current head's CI.
